metadataRaw.title: Instant Elbow Pain Relief
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows an easy exercise that can give instant elbow pain relief.

This exercise will focus on loosening up the soft tissues around the elbow through movements using a simple weight (like a water bottle).

Let us know how it works for you!
